description: OpsAgent approval-gated Active Directory domain join using a Secrets Manager credential.

DomainCredentialSecretId.description: Secrets Manager name or ARN containing username and password JSON properties.

OrganizationalUnitPath.description: Optional distinguished name of the destination computer OU.

runCommand: if ($computer.PartOfDomain -and $computer.Domain -ieq $domain) { Write-Output "VERIFIED: Computer is already joined to $domain."; exit 0 }
if (-not (Get-Command Get-SECSecretValue -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'AWS Tools for PowerShell SecretsManager cmdlets are required on this server.' }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($secretResponse.SecretString)) { throw 'The domain credential secret must contain a JSON SecretString.' }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($secret.username) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($secret.password)) { throw 'The secret JSON must contain username and password properties.' }
Write-Output "VERIFIED: Domain join accepted for $domain. Restart is required to complete membership."
